title: Barnala Steel Industries Ltd. v. Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. and Anr.
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J. & Vipin Sinha, J.
disposition: Writ petition disposed of; the demand of a bank guarantee for the additional-security amount quashed, the consumer to comply with the other conditions of the load-enhancement sanction
headnote: Additional security demanded on enhancement of load is not 'dues' within Clause 4.49 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and a bank guarantee for such additional security cannot be demanded - following the coordinate Division Bench in Tehri Girders Ltd. v. PVVNL, against which no SLP was filed. The petitioner's load enhancement was sanctioned (25.5.2013) subject to furnishing a bank guarantee of Rs. 2,66,70,160 for the additional-security amount. Applying Tehri Girders (para 30), which held that Clause 4.49 speaks of 'recovery of any dues' and additional security is not a recoverable due (its only consequence on non-payment being non-release of load / discontinuance of supply), the Court held the bank-guarantee demand unjustified and quashed it, while directing compliance with the sanction's other conditions.

holding_units.topic: Additional security is not 'dues' under Clause 4.49; no bank guarantee for it
holding_units.question: Can a licensee demand a bank guarantee under Clause 4.49 for the additional-security amount payable on load enhancement?
holding_units.holding: No. Following the coordinate Division Bench in Tehri Girders Ltd. v. PVVNL (unchallenged by any SLP), Clause 4.49 is attracted only where recovery of 'dues' has been stayed; additional security is not a recoverable due (the sole consequence of its non-payment being non-release of the additional load and discontinuance of supply). The demand of a bank guarantee for the additional-security amount was therefore not in accordance with law and was quashed, the consumer being directed to comply with the sanction's other conditions.
holding_units.limiting_facts: Load enhancement sanctioned on 25.5.2013 subject to a bank guarantee of Rs. 2,66,70,160 for additional security; consumer willing to meet the other conditions.

principle_tags.application: Additional security on load enhancement is not a recoverable 'due'; Clause 4.49 is not attracted and a bank guarantee for it cannot be demanded.

lead_authorities.name: Tehri Girders Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.

authorities.name: Tehri Girders Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
